scope: All four connected online agent writes and version-pinned deny-by-default offline policy

environment.provider: synthetic supervised process; no live model turn
environment.native_ownership: authenticated signed helper, live owned process and actual held flock

online_proof: Canonical session binding and all four writes traverse compiled stdio, fixed daemon RPC, possession-authenticated Worker, WorkspaceHub and D1
Task updates preserve the original creator and use optimistic resource versions
Comments, progress and proposed tasks carry agent-run provenance without impersonating a human
Absent progress metadata stays absent while explicit zero and bounded fractional percent/confidence are retained
Root proposals stay proposed; bounded children target only the source task and use shared C08 rules
Current authority and root policy precede cached outcomes; expected version and child count apply only to a new effect
Lost replies and MCP/daemon restart retries preserve original identity and produce one canonical effect
Changed input under the same identity conflicts, including after a previously committed update
Real L06 session ingestion, authenticated native helper, actual held flock and pre/post-network containment checks remain enforced
Post-commit delivery denial preserves the committed effect while withholding the private result
Raw progress and version numerics are checked before rounding; equivalent exponent and signed-zero retries retain identity
Named progress decimal support leaves frozen general v1 schemas and fixtures unchanged
policy_proof: Migration 0039 adds explicit deny defaults to all six current/history policy tables
Exact immutable policy versions retain historical launch snapshot and repository canonical hashes
Complete settings and normalized offline permission bind to a versioned action-specific passkey target
Current direct-human authorization precedes cached policy outcomes
Proof consumption, guarded head, immutable history and outcome commit atomically; losing guards roll back the batch
Repository omission means deny; explicit permission, including explicit deny, requires its own bound proof
Project and repository permission can only remove tools or shorten the configured age
Native YAML and TypeScript canonicalization share deterministic permission fixtures without widening the frozen launch projection
The owner policy form completes action-bound passkey verification in a real browser
Fixture-only current security clocks preserve historical launch and lease scenarios without weakening production expiry checks
remaining_obligations: Daemon-owned write-ahead records for online operations with checked durable acknowledgements
Complete short-lived confirmation, protected capture and immutable admission modes
Atomic legacy journal quarantine, bounded exclusive claims and restart-safe replay
Truthful pending, applied, rejected and delivery-blocked receipts without private cache bypass
Complete A01 runtime acceptance and downstream recertification
